summary: Detroit is a dynamic Midwestern hub rich in automotive history, stunning Art Deco architecture, and a thriving music legacy. From world-class museums and street art to waterfront parks and authentic Coney Island hot dog stands, the city offers affordable exploration of American industrial heritage and contemporary cultural renewal.

restaurants.name: Lafayette Coney Island
restaurants.description: Historic Detroit institution since 1914 serving iconic Coney Island hot dogs with chili and mustard. A must-visit for authentic Detroit street food tradition.

restaurants.name: Slows Bar BQ
restaurants.description: Award-winning barbecue joint in Corktown featuring slow-smoked meats and inventive sides. Known for bourbon selection and rustic-chic atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Zingerman's Delicatessen
restaurants.description: Legendary Ann Arbor-born deli with Detroit location offering artisanal sandwiches and imported specialty foods. Perfect for gourmet picnics and lunch.

restaurants.name: Harry's Detroit Bar & Grill
restaurants.description: Classic upscale American dining with an extensive martini menu and nostalgic 1940s ambiance. Located in the historic Book Building downtown.

restaurants.name: Selden Standard
restaurants.description: Contemporary American fine dining in Corktown featuring locally-sourced ingredients and creative seasonal menus. Intimate setting with craft cocktails.

restaurants.name: Buddy's Pizza
restaurants.description: Detroit-famous square pizza with thick, airy crust and crispy cheese edges. Local institution with multiple locations throughout the city.

restaurants.name: Via Stella
restaurants.description: Upscale Italian restaurant in Corktown with housemade pasta and Italian wine list. Romantic ambiance with wood-fired kitchen.

restaurants.name: Ima
restaurants.description: Japanese ramen and soba noodle house in Midtown with rich broths and quality toppings. Casual setting with quick service.

restaurants.name: Café N深
restaurants.description: Authentic Vietnamese pho and banh mi sandwiches in Southwest Detroit. Affordable authentic cuisine with generous portions.

restaurants.name: The Apparatus Room
restaurants.description: Sophisticated cocktail bar and restaurant in historic firehouse serving elevated comfort food. Craft cocktails and curated wine selection.

restaurants.name: Café Gratitude
restaurants.description: Plant-based cafe in Midtown offering organic vegan bowls, smoothies, and fresh juices. Bright, healthy casual dining.

restaurants.name: The Columbo Steakhouse
restaurants.description: Classic Detroit steakhouse with dry-aged beef, seafood, and elegant 1950s-style dining room. Professional service and wine cellar.

activities.name: Detroit Institute of Arts
activities.description: World-class art museum featuring the famous Detroit Industry Murals by Diego Rivera and extensive collections from ancient to contemporary periods. Free admission for Michigan residents.

activities.name: Henry Ford Museum
activities.description: Massive museum dedicated to American innovation with historic vehicles, presidential limousines, and the Rosa Parks bus. Engaging and comprehensive automotive and cultural history.

activities.name: Detroit River Walk
activities.description: Beautiful 3.5-mile paved riverfront path connecting downtown to Belle Isle with parks, public art, and scenic views of the Windsor waterfront. Perfect for walking, running, or cycling.

activities.name: Motown Museum
activities.description: Historic Hitsville USA studio where Motown records were produced, featuring exhibits on legendary artists like The Supremes and Marvin Gaye. Intimate look at music history.

activities.name: Street Art Tour in Corktown
activities.description: Walk through Detroit's vibrant street art district featuring murals by renowned artists and ever-changing graffiti art. Self-guided or organized tours available.

activities.name: Belle Isle Park Exploration
activities.description: Historic island park with botanical gardens, nature trails, historic lighthouse, and scenic observation tower overlooking Detroit and Windsor. Multiple attractions in one accessible destination.

activities.name: Guardian Building Art Deco Tour
activities.description: Stunning 1929 Art Deco skyscraper with ornate tilework, vaulted ceilings, and historical significance. Self-guided lobby exploration or organized architectural tours available.

activities.name: Detroit Brewing Company Tour
activities.description: Local craft brewery offering guided tours of the production facility and tasting rooms with seasonal beers. Family-friendly with food trucks and events.

activities.name: Hitsville USA Night Tour
activities.description: Evening walking tour through historic downtown Detroit covering music venues, speakeasies, and live performance spots. Discover Detroit's vibrant nightlife culture.

activities.name: Fisher Building Arcade Shopping
activities.description: Historic 1928 Art Deco shopping arcade with ornate ceiling, vintage shops, and architectural details. Free exploration of one of Detroit's most beautiful indoor spaces.

activities.name: Heidelberg Project Art District
activities.description: Outdoor community art project covering entire blocks with colorful painted houses, polka dots, and thought-provoking installations. Unique and ever-evolving artistic expression.

activities.name: Michigan Science Center
activities.description: Interactive science museum with OMNIMAX theater, hands-on exhibits, and planetarium shows. Engaging for all ages with focus on innovation and discovery.

spots.name: Guardian Building Lobby
spots.description: Spectacular Art Deco interior with turquoise and gold tilework, vaulted ceilings, and dramatic lighting creating stunning architectural photography opportunities.

spots.name: Detroit Institute of Arts Exterior
spots.description: Iconic Beaux-Arts facade with classical columns and ornate stonework, especially beautiful in golden hour light against Detroit skyline.

spots.name: Heidelberg Project Houses
spots.description: Vibrant polka-dotted and colorfully painted residential buildings creating bold street art photography with dynamic colors and bold patterns.

spots.name: Detroit River Walk with Windsor Skyline
spots.description: Scenic waterfront location capturing both Detroit's skyline and Windsor's lights reflected in calm river water.

spots.name: Fisher Building Art Deco Lobby
spots.description: Historic 1928 arcade with soaring ceilings, ornate details, and dramatic interior architecture perfect for symmetrical and geometric compositions.

spots.name: Corktown Brick Industrial Buildings
spots.description: Historic brick warehouses and factories with character, street murals, and industrial aesthetic creating rich texture and urban photography.

spots.name: Motown Museum Hitsville USA
spots.description: Historic recording studio exterior and signage with nostalgic Motown-era details perfect for vintage and cultural photography.

spots.name: Belle Isle Lighthouse
spots.description: Historic white lighthouse against sky and water, framed by trees and gardens offering classic landscape and architectural photography.

spots.name: Downtown Detroit Skyline from Perspective
spots.description: Urban skyline featuring mix of Art Deco and modern architecture with distinctive silhouette against sky.

spots.name: Street Art Murals in Midtown
spots.description: Diverse collection of large-scale murals and contemporary street art on building sides and alleyways with vibrant colors and artistic styles.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm ultra-wide for architectural interiors and comprehensive street scenes
24-70mm versatile zoom for general exploration and varied compositions
70-200mm telephoto for skyline compression and isolated details
50mm prime for street portraits and environmental storytelling
photography.goldenHourNotes: Detroit's golden hour is particularly striking along the Detroit River Walk where light reflects off water and illuminates historic architecture in warm tones. The Guardian Building and surrounding Art Deco structures take on rich amber and gold hues during sunset. Morning light is excellent for the Heidelberg Project's colorful houses and street art in Corktown.

weather.seasonality: Detroit experiences four distinct seasons with cold snowy winters and warm mild summers. Spring and fall offer pleasant temperatures ideal for walking tours and outdoor photography, while summer is peak season with festivals and outdoor activities.
weather.summary: Winter temperatures drop below freezing with frequent snow, while summer brings warm comfortable weather. Spring and autumn provide the most pleasant conditions for exploring the city's architectural and cultural attractions.

hotels.name: HI Detroit Hostel
hotels.description: Affordable hostel in downtown location with shared and private rooms, community kitchen, and social atmosphere.

hotels.name: The Westin Detroit Metropolitan Airport
hotels.description: Reliable chain hotel convenient to airport with modern amenities, fitness center, and on-site restaurant.

hotels.name: The Siren Hotel
hotels.description: Boutique luxury hotel in historic Corktown with rooftop pool, fine dining, and stylish contemporary design in restored building.
